rv.q: "Stalker" is the sinister title of the entertaining mind-bender of a magic show performed by the Swedish duo known as Brynolf & Ljung.
I'm still convinced it's all tricks but darn these guys are good.
Stalker emerges as muddled, split between wanting to demystify magic and still leave audiences in awe of it.
This show combines street magic, illusions and physical mentalism, leaving you mystified.
